title: Heart bypass and playing drums again
summary: He had a heart bypass the next year but still drums, plays in the Leisuretown band and drives.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: It was eight years. And then the following year he had to have a heart bypass.
Chauncey has a deep trunk aorta all the way from here to...It wasn't even a full year.
He certainly was. But with all that he...
With all that, you're still playing drums.
He joined the Leisuretown band here. We used to go to the dances. Well, we went to several of them. We used to go for all these jazz... You've run this...
Do you have a band here?
loved Chauncey. Everybody had a great time. He was driving. He drove a car.
In past years, things like this ...The aneurisms are all presently little strokes that take place, you see. He was not supposed to even be here.
